description: rounD provides naturalistic road-user trajectories at roundabouts, collected using drones. The provider is fka / leveLXData. Geographical and temporal coverage: The rounD benchmark concerns German roundabouts and is published by RWTH Aachen researchers through leveLXData. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is free for academic and research purposes; exact reuse terms require provider agreement. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
